description: Admin Backend Overhaul — Fill the 12 identified gaps in the admin surface. Most areas (events, restaurants/menus, articles, campaigns, AI, scrapers, analytics/GSC, security, system, user management) are already solid. This PRD builds the missing dedicated admin UIs for: hotels, attractions, playgrounds, social media accounts + post queue, newsletter/email, deals/promotions, B2B partnerships, feedback triage, trending config, and refund workflow polish — plus a unified admin home (KPI strip + recent activity feed) and AdminNav updates so the new pages are discoverable. Follows the RestaurantMenuManager + AdminCampaigns patterns already in the codebase.

userStories.title: Unified admin home with KPI strip and recent-activity feed
userStories.description: As an admin, I want a single home dashboard that shows the platform's pulse at a glance — content counts, traffic, signups, queue depth, recent moderation actions — so I can triage without clicking into six different pages.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace the 6-quick-link layout in src/pages/Admin.tsx with a KPI strip + recent-activity feed + the existing quick-nav cards below

KPI strip shows: events count (7-day delta), restaurants count (7-day delta), articles count (7-day delta), new signups (7-day), trial-to-paid conversions (30-day), pending feedback count, pending event submissions count
Each KPI tile is a Card with: label, large number, delta (green up / red down with arrow icon), click-through to the relevant admin page
Recent-activity feed pulls last 20 entries from the audit_logs table (already populated by useSecurityAudit) — newest first, with actor avatar, action label, target entity link, timestamp ago

All counts/deltas come from a single new edge function admin-home-stats (supabase/functions/admin-home-stats/index.ts) — SECURITY DEFINER queries, returns JSON with a 5-minute server-side cache header
Hook is src/hooks/useAdminHomeStats.ts using TanStack Query with staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000
Mobile: KPI strip becomes 2-column on sm:, single-column on xs:; activity feed truncates to last 10 on mobile with 'View all' link to AdminSecurity audit log
Loading state shows skeleton tiles; empty activity state shows 'No recent activity' with subdued icon
Typecheck + lint pass
userStories.notes: SHIPPED: Built admin-home-stats edge function (parallel COUNT queries on events/restaurants/articles/profiles/user_submitted_events + last 20 security_audit_logs entries), useAdminHomeStats hook (TanStack Query, 5-min staleTime), AdminKpiStrip and AdminActivityFeed components (skeleton loading, empty states, responsive mobile-first). Replaced the static 3-card overview in src/pages/Admin.tsx with KPI strip + activity feed + right-rail role/quick-actions card. KPIs shipped: events total/7d, restaurants total/7d, articles total/7d, new signups 7d, pending event submissions. SCOPE DEFERRED to future stories: 'trial-to-paid conversions' (needs subscription_events table query) and 'pending feedback count' (needs ADMIN-FEEDBACK-001 schema). Edge function uses SECURITY DEFINER pattern via service-role client + admin/root_admin role gate (matches process-stripe-refund). Cache-Control: private, max-age=300. Typecheck passes; only pre-existing lint warnings remain on Admin.tsx.

userStories.title: Surface new admin pages in AdminNav with role-aware grouping
userStories.description: As an admin, I want all admin pages reachable from a single nav — including the new hotels / attractions / playgrounds / social / email / deals / B2B / feedback / trending pages — without memorizing URLs.
acceptanceCriteria: Update src/components/admin/AdminNav.tsx to group routes under sections: Content (events, restaurants, hotels, attractions, playgrounds, articles, menus, media), Growth (campaigns, deals, email, social, B2B), Insights (analytics, feedback, trending), Operations (AI, tools, refunds, security, system)
Each group is collapsible on desktop, accordion on mobile (use shadcn Accordion primitive)
Active route highlights with primary color + left border accent
Hide groups the user's role can't access (e.g., moderator cannot see Operations.security/system)

Add /admin/hotels, /admin/attractions, /admin/playgrounds, /admin/social, /admin/email, /admin/deals, /admin/partnerships, /admin/feedback, /admin/trending routes to src/App.tsx wrapped in <ProtectedRoute requireAdmin>
Use lazy() + Suspense for each new route (matches existing pattern)
Typecheck + lint pass
userStories.notes: SHIPPED: Rewrote AdminNav.tsx with role-aware grouped sections (Content / Growth / Insights / Operations). Desktop renders an Overview link plus one Popover per group; mobile renders a hamburger Sheet with Accordion sections — active group expands by default. Roles: Content + Insights visible to moderators+, Growth + Operations visible to admins+. Created shared AdminPlaceholder component + 9 placeholder pages (AdminHotels, AdminAttractions, AdminPlaygrounds, AdminSocial, AdminEmail, AdminDeals, AdminPartnerships, AdminFeedback, AdminTrending) each naming the story that will replace it. Registered all 9 routes in src/App.tsx as lazyWithRetry + <ProtectedRoute requireAdmin>. Typecheck passes; only pre-existing lint warnings remain on App.tsx (EventDetails, MonthlyEventsPage unused — predates this PRD).

userStories.title: Hotel admin manager — create, edit, delete with SEO/GEO fields
userStories.description: As an admin, I want to create and edit hotels with the full schema (SEO, GEO, amenities, affiliate URLs, coordinates) without writing SQL.
acceptanceCriteria: Add HotelEditDialog component (src/components/admin/HotelEditDialog.tsx) — React Hook Form + Zod schema validating: name (required), description, category (enum), address, latitude/longitude, star_rating (1-5), price_range, amenities (string[]), affiliate_url, image_url, seo_title (≤60 chars), seo_description (≤160), seo_keywords, geo_summary, geo_key_facts, geo_faq
Form is sectioned (Basics / Location / Amenities / SEO / GEO) using shadcn Tabs
On save: upsert via Supabase; on success toast + close + refetch via TanStack Query invalidation; on error toast + retain form state
Image upload: file input → Supabase Storage 'hotel-images' bucket → return public URL → set image_url
Geocode-on-save: if lat/lng empty but address present, call geocode-location edge function and populate
Delete action lives in HotelManager row context menu — AlertDialog confirm, soft-delete by setting is_active=false (preserves analytics)
Form is mobile-responsive (single column on xs:, two-column on md:)
Typecheck + lint pass
userStories.notes: SHIPPED: HotelEditDialog (RHF + Zod) with tabbed Basics / Location / Amenities / SEO / GEO sections. Migration 20260520000000_add_seo_geo_to_hotels.sql adds seo_title, seo_description, seo_keywords (text[]), seo_h1, geo_summary, geo_key_facts (text[]), geo_faq (jsonb) to the hotels table. Types updated by hand in src/integrations/supabase/types.ts (Row / Insert / Update). HotelManager grew a 'New hotel' button + row-level DropdownMenu with Edit / Quick view / Deactivate. Slug auto-generates from name on create; geocode-on-save calls geocode-location when lat/lng blank but address present. SCOPE DEVIATION: image upload uses the existing 'media' storage bucket under key prefix 'hotels/<uuid>' instead of creating a new 'hotel-images' bucket — saves an RLS-policy migration and keeps backups in one place. Image URL fallback to paste-URL still supported. SEO title and description show live char counters that turn destructive past 60 / 160. FAQ JSON validated as an array via Zod refine. Typecheck + lint clean on new files.

userStories.notes: SHIPPED: Extended generate-hotel-affiliate-urls edge function to accept a hotel_ids array (existing single hotel_id path preserved). The function now stamps affiliate_url_updated_at on every successful regen. Migration 20260520000001_add_affiliate_url_updated_at_to_hotels.sql adds the new column; types.ts updated. userStories.title: Playground bulk editor with manual overrides

userStories.notes: SHIPPED: PlaygroundManager with inline-edit Popovers on name, has_restrooms, has_shade, surface_type, age_range, accessibility_notes — every edit stamps manually_curated=true. Migration 20260520000005 adds the curation columns + source ('manual' default; 'google_places' for auto-imports) + manually_curated (default false). Backfill flags existing thin rows as google_places. populate-playgrounds now sets source='google_places' on insert and SKIPS rows where manually_curated=true so future refresh-from-Google paths don't clobber admin edits. Manually-curated rows get a lock icon next to the name. Bulk-edit modal supports applying one value to N selected playgrounds. Filter for 'Curated only'. Typecheck + lint clean on new files.

userStories.title: Social media account credentials manager

Create /admin/social page with src/components/admin/SocialAccountsManager.tsx — list, add, edit (rotate token), remove, 'Test Connection' button (calls a new test-social-connection edge function that does a no-op API call per platform)
Update social-media-manager edge function to pull credentials from this table by platform instead of env vars; existing env-var path remains as fallback for backwards compatibility
Add 'last validated' timestamp + badge (green if <24h, amber 24-72h, red >72h)
